REQ-0010.Requirement: The system shall allow a user to access, create, edit, or revise a document in Enlil

REQ-0020.Requirement: The system shall clearly indicate the state of the document being viewed

REQ-0030.Requirement:
The system shall display the following default columns on the landing page for the documents list: Document ID, 
Revision (major only), 
Document Title, 
Document Type, 
Document Owner, 
the associated AR ID, 
Document Status, and 
Effective Date 
(this list defines content, not column header names)

REQ-0040.Requirement: The system should provide a mechanism to export the Document List (e.g. to a .csv format)

REQ-0050.Requirement: The system shall only display documents in the documents list (e.g. records can be found in their respective modules or in the records list)

REQ-0060.Requirement: The system shall allow the user to filter the displayed Document List for each of the columns displayed on the landing page

REQ-0070.Requirement: The system shall default the Document List filter to display released documents when starting a new Enlil session

REQ-0080.Requirement: The system shall maintain Document List filter settings during an Enlil session when navigating away from and back to the Document List landing page

REQ-0090.Requirement: The system shall default to the Document List being sorted by most recent edited first

REQ-0100.Requirement: The system shall provide a mechanism to clear all Document List filters

REQ-0110.Requirement: The system shall display the number of documents displayed that match the filter settings

REQ-0120.Requirement: The system shall allow the user to open a document from within the Document List

REQ-0130.Requirement: The system should display the description of the document when the mouse hovers over the document title in the Document List

REQ-0140.Requirement: The system shall provide a mechanism for the user to create a document from the Document List landing page

REQ-0150.Requirement: The system shall allow a user to revise a document that is in the Released state

REQ-0160.Requirement: The system shall provide the following editable document attributes when creating or revising a document: (Document Title, Document Description, Document Type, Document Revision Stage, Reference, Training Required, Attachments, Users (document access privileges), Groups (document access privileges), Document Owner Assignment)

REQ-0170.Requirement: The system shall allow the user to edit document ID, when creating a document.

REQ-0180.Requirement: The system shall allow the document owner to add one or more references to a document in draft state

REQ-0190.Requirement: The system shall allow the document owner to remove references to a document in draft state

REQ-0200.Requirement: The system shall allow the document owner to upload one or more  attachments to a document in draft state

REQ-0210.Requirement: The system support attachments of multiple types.

REQ-0220.Requirement: The system shall allow the document owner to upload multiple documents at once

REQ-0230.Requirement: The system shall notify the user if a document upload failure occurs

REQ-0240.Requirement: The system shall allow the document owner to remove uploaded attachments for a document in draft state

REQ-0250.Requirement: The system shall allow the document owner to identify a single attachment as the primary attachment for a document

REQ-0260.Requirement: The system shall allow the document owner to identify any attachment as a redline

REQ-0270.Requirement: The system shall default the training to required, if the particular Document Type requires training in the Document Approval Matrix

REQ-0280.Requirement: The system shall default the training to required, if the  previous revision of the particular document required training

REQ-0290.Requirement: The system shall allow the user to deselect training required,  if the default state was training required

REQ-0300.Requirement: The system shall default user/group access to Everyone for new documents

REQ-0320.Requirement: The system shall automatically generate and display a document number when a document is created based on the system configuration for the particular Document Type

REQ-0330.Requirement: The system shall automatically set the document status as Draft when creating or revising a document

REQ-0340.Requirement: The system shall allow the document owner to change document ownership to another user

REQ-0350.Requirement: The system shall allow the document owner to cancel the document draft.  A confirmation dialog is required.

REQ-0360.Requirement: The system shall maintain a history of attribute changes

REQ-0370.Requirement: The system shall allow the user to select the type of revision change, options include next revision, upgrade revision state, administrative, or obsolete, when revising a document and if the option is applicable.

REQ-0380.Requirement: The system shall require a password for a user to access attachments of documents if the document is in Obsolete state

REQ-0390.Requirement: The system shall require a password for a user to access redlines of documents if the document is not in draft state

REQ-0400.Requirement: The system shall allow the user to create a Document Type

REQ-0410.Requirement: The system shall support multiple Document Types as needed by the customer

REQ-0420.Requirement: The system shall allow the user to define a Document Type as QMS or non-QMS. QMS default access everyone and Non-QMS default access only owner

REQ-0440.Requirement: The system shall allow the user to assign a document prefix to a Document Type at the time of creation of the Document Type

REQ-0450.Requirement: The system shall support a sequential numbering by company or by prefix for each Document Type. A starting number will be set per document type.

REQ-0460.Requirement: The system shall support multiple Document Types to share the same prefix. All documents sharing the same prefix shall share sequential numbering system

REQ-0480.Requirement: The system shall maintain a descriptive name for every Document Type

REQ-0490.Requirement: The system shall allow the user to assign a Document Type to an Enlil Document Class

REQ-0510.Requirement: When viewing the Document List, only Document Types defined as Enlil Document Class of Document shall be visible

REQ-0520.Requirement: The Document Approval Matrix shall be enforced for managing approvals to all Enlil Document Classes with the exception of PO's

REQ-0530.Requirement: For Document Types assigned to an Enlil Document Class of Document, the system shall include the Document Type in the Document List, and utilizes the Document Approval Matrix to manage changes/approvals

REQ-0550.Requirement: For items with an Enlil Document Class of Dynamic Form, the system shall include these Document Types as selectable items when creating custom forms

REQ-0560.Requirement: For items with an Enlil Document Class of PI, the system shall allow addition of these Document Types as process instructions on electronic LHR's

REQ-0570.Requirement: For items with an Enlil Document Class of PO, the system shall display these Document Types on the PO List, and utilize PO approval matrix to manage changes/approvals

REQ-0580.Requirement: The system shall only display the major revision of a document, except for in the revision history of the document

REQ-3610.Requirement: The system shall allow the authorized user to configure Start number, Prefix for document, and labelling for Enlil items.
